t: Placing a $(5)Sponge Module$() in a $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() makes it continually detect and remove any fluids contained within the field. The rate at which fluids are removed can be increased by installing $(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)Speed Module$()s. Higher rates may be needed for removing infinite fluids, such as Water.
在$(5)力场投影仪$()中放置$(l:mffs:machines/projector)海绵模块$()，可使其持续侦测并清除力场内部所有流体。通过安装$(l:mffs:upgrade_modules/speed_module)$(5)速度模块$()，可加快流体清除速率。对于水等无限流体，可能需要更高的清除速率。
